says.ask: %s is on my floor. If it's a snake, that's sport. If it's a rock, it fell on one of mine. Out.
says.wait: %s is still out there. My people are watching the ceiling.
says.ready: %s is gone? Ha. And nothing fell on anyone.
says.thanks: The Crew pays its debts. It's what keeps us out of the walls.

says.ask: ...I want %s. ...it is on this floor. ...I do not move. You do.
says.ready: ...that is %s. ...put it down. ...gently. Not soft. Gently.

says.ask: %s is one of my little ones, and far too brave. Don't pop them. Please.
says.wait: Is %s still wobbling? Keep them wobbling.
says.ready: %s came home, whole. I felt it through the floor.
says.failed: You popped %s. I asked so nicely. Go away.
says.thanks: You could have. You didn't. The dragons would be proud. Take this.

says.ask: %s huntsss my kind for sssport. End the hunt. I will not asssk how.
says.wait: %s ssstill walksss. We are patient. Not endlessssly.
says.ready: %s is gone. The count is one ssshorter.
says.thanks: The Coil remembersss a debt both waysss. Take thisss.

pact.title: %s SWEARS TO YOU
pact.line: %s keeps its gate for you, and none of its own will turn on you now.

redemption.ask: My clan has your name cut into it. Do this one thing, and I will not send another after you.
redemption.wait: The thing is not done. My clan still watches for you.
redemption.ready: Done. You gave, where you could have taken.
redemption.done_line: %s does not forgive you. It stops sending its own after you.
